# GitHub — Workflows & CI

GitHub Actions workflows within free limits (local git + local test runs are the fallback if free-tier limits change). Status: ci.yml runs only the environment check and a secrets-sanity check; backend/frontend test jobs are added by those teams when their suites exist.

Status date: 2026-11-04 (Phase 2, Team A skeleton). If this directory's status changes, update this README in the same commit.
